correctness.rationale: Conditional on fair unary colors, let B be signed color imbalance; B/sqrt(n) -> N(0,1). The row signed sums D_v are independent differences of two binomials with edge probability r=1-epsilon. For root children, excluding its self-loop, the balance difference T_n is conditional sum of n-1 i.i.d. {-1,0,1} terms with probabilities r q_(-1)(B), r q_0(B); the omitted root self-term is nonzero with probability O(n^-1/2). In epsilon>=c/log n, an exponentially tilted lattice local CLT at deviations B=O(sqrt n) yields q_j~(2pi n r epsilon)^-1/2 exp(-(rB-j)^2/(2nr epsilon)), j=0,-1, so the expected number of balanced children M_n has log M_n/log n->1/2-Z²/(2a) when epsilon log n->a>0. The conditional sign is 1/2 below |Z|<sqrt(a), and zero-event true with probability 1 above that threshold, producing 3/2-Phi(sqrt(a)); Bernstein handles a=0, CLT a=infinity; subsequence compactness yields moving-parameter o(1). Finite independent row convolution for n=5, K=2, r=3/4 gave q0=149/512 and q-1=87/1024. This finite check does not validate the local-CLT asymptotic.
